csv_project_name: A/E for Elroy Sparta Trail Tunnel Door Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: to provide design through construction administration services as indicated in the DFD Policy and Procedure Manual for Architects/Engineers and Consultants and the DFD AE Contract for Professional Services for the design and reconstruction of Trail Tunnel Portal stone facade and doors. The project will replace wooden doors and repair the stone facade at entrances to tunnels #1, #2, & #3 on Elroy Sparta Trail, stabilize of the bedrock and earthen slopes around these entrances, and repair the Stone Flume at Tunnel #3
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater
